title: CE31104: Statistical Methods In Hydrology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to probability and statistics applications in hydrology: random
variables and their statistical properties, commonly used probability
distributions in hydrology, Bayes theory. Statistical analysis of hydrologic
data: frequency analysis, hypothesis testing, analysis of variance. Hydrologic
time series analysis and forecasting: stationarity and ergodicity, fitting and
forecasting using ARIMA models, Bayesian approach, prior and posterior
distribution.
